---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use case

Describe the problem this solves or the scenario where this would be useful.
> "As a user who holds [X], I need [Y] because [Z]."

## Proposed solution

How you think this could be implemented (optional — the maintainer may have a different approach).

## Alternatives considered

Other ways you could achieve the same goal today, and why they fall short.

## Islamic jurisprudence relevance (if applicable)

If this relates to a Zakat ruling or asset class, please include the scholarly basis or cite sources so the guidance text can be accurate.

## Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, links to relevant scholarly sources, or anything else.
